descriptions.description: Airopsis is a genus of southern European and northern African plants in the grass family.Grassbase – The World Online Grass Flora Species The only accepted species is Airopsis tenella, native to the western Mediterranean: Portugal, Spain, France incl Corsica, Italy incl Sicily, Algeria, Tunisia, Morocco.Altervista Flora Italiana, Nebbia globosa, Airopsis tenella (Cav.) Coss. & Durieu formerly included Numerous other species were once included in Airopsis but are now regarded as better suited to other genera, including Aira Antinoria Dissanthelium Eragrostis Pentameris Periballia Poa Sphenopholis
